ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local merchant pricing and competitor intelligence platform designed specifically for college campuses and surrounding student-hub vendors, using predictive modeling to dynamically suggest optimal pricing strategies.
ideas.title: CampusCartel AI Price Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven hackathon-winning architecture combining predictive regression and business intelligence, tailored to solve real student-vendor commerce problems visible to judges at IIM Indore.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision platform that tracks and predicts daily food waste generation in institutional dining halls like hostels and mess facilities to optimize procurement and reduce overhead costs.
ideas.title: MessWaste AI Vision Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses operational inefficiency in massive campus cafeterias, hitting close to home for IIM Indore judges who deal with campus logistics daily.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG-powered student support and curriculum navigation platform that parses course syllabi, assignment histories, and peer notes to generate hyper-personalized study roadmaps and risk alerts.
ideas.title: StudyGraph Multi-Agent Academic Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent orchestration and LangGraph workflows similar to international hackathon winners, targeting the universal pain point of student burnout and academic planning.

ideas.pitch: A zero-friction, automated expense splitting and recurring settlement app tailored for college group living, utilizing smart ledger caching and trust scoring to eliminate roommate disputes.
ideas.title: HostelLedger Decentralized Expense Splitter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday, highly relatable problem for undergraduate students living away from home, ensuring immediate engagement from both judges and audience members.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven event discovery and trust engine for college fests and clubs that aggregates fragmented student events, automatically builds personalized itineraries, and predicts attendance surges using demographic trends.
ideas.title: EventPulse Campus Engagement Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the chaos of college fest management, leveraging high utility for university student bodies and event organizers at the host institute.
